column1: # The plain dump size score (0207, D2901, D2906), per case: SUITE, CASE, then the bytes of
# its plain dumps at every idle point, raw and gzip -9 per dump, without the corpus prelude
# and the harvest harness (scripts/dump-size `env`). Suites: corpus (difftest --plain-out),
# v2 (the v2/golden programs, plain_dumps_at_every_idle_point with DJS_PLAIN_OUT), sleep (the
# sleep-dump example, the_sleep_example_dumps with DJS_SLEEP_OUT). The gate leg "plain dumps
# (djs and node)" fails when a case grows; a new case only asks for its line. Rewrite with
#   node scripts/dump-size/dump-size.ts --score tests/scores/dump-size.tsv --update corpus=DIR v2=DIR sleep=DIR
